dedupe_keys.name: industrial machinery stocks in 337 cities 1978 2020 weight and embodied materials

description: This dataset estimates the in-use stock of industrial machinery in 337 cities from 1978 to 2020. The figshare record says it holds 14,491 records of the total weight of industrial machinery and of the materials embodied in it, by city and year. It was published on 18 April 2023 in the Springer Nature figshare repository by ten authors (Xiang Li, Lulu Song, Qiance Liu, Xin Ouyang, Ting Mao, Haojie Lu, Litao Liu, Xiaojie Liu, Wei-Qiang Chen and Gang Liu) as one downloadable Excel file of about 215 KB, free under CC0. Coverage is 337 cities; the country is not stated on the page read, and they are most likely Chinese prefecture-level cities (inferred from the count). Caveats: the stocks are modelled estimates, the method and the material categories are described in an associated paper that was not read, and the description is very brief. For simulation it gives city-level industrial capital stock as an exposure layer, to weight how much machinery a flood or earthquake could damage in each city and to model replacement demand after a disaster. Related catalogue records include the inventory of industrial solid waste in 337 Chinese cities and the Chinese industrial emissions database.
